$description: Maggi persona design system: single source of truth for Claude Design and Claude Code. Values follow the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) shape ($value/$type/$description). Aliases use {dot.path} syntax. Edit this file only; per-persona files in personas/ are generated by tools/build-tokens.py.

meta.statusNote: Gate 1 proposal. Every value below is design judgement unless it carries a brief section reference. Nothing is locked until Gate 1 approval.
meta.precedence: Part II (Sections 16-28) overrides Part I on conflict.
meta.colourFormat: 6-digit sRGB hex. Contrast per WCAG 2.2; colour-vision simulation per Machado et al. 2009 (severity 1.0); colour difference = OKLab Euclidean distance x100.
meta.brandLockup: Private design-gig project (decision 2026-10-07): real MAGGI logo and real Nestle MAGGI packaging may be used. Brand images stay in git-ignored brief/references/ and are never committed. No slogans invented as MAGGI's; no health claims (Section 22 still applies).
meta.fontLicence: All proposed families are distributed on Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License. Re-verify licence before commercial release.

brand.$description: Shared constants. Personas re-render these through their own constraint; they never redefine them (Section 6, 9).

red.$description: Maggi-inspired red energy. Inspired, not sampled from real packaging.

ink.$description: Warm near-black for shared system text.

heritage-thread.$description: Two-band rule, red above yellow, each band = 1 persona stroke width, 1:1 ratio. At most once per layout. Never a flag motif (Section 6).

space.$description: 4-point base spacing scale shared by every persona. Stack may only use the 8-multiples.

min-size.$description: Minimum type size per medium (Section 21). Packaging minimums must also meet local labelling law.

line-height.$description: Defaults; personas override. Text line-height >= 1.5 satisfies WCAG 1.4.12.

touch-target.$description: WCAG 2.5.5 target size. Nest raises this to 56px.

sachet.$description: Shared prop (Section 18.3). Constant geometry in every world, in rig units on the 1024 canvas. Colour comes from each persona's role.sachet-red / role.sachet-yellow.

crimp.$value: 12-unit band at top and bottom edges, serrated with 8-unit teeth

split.$value: Straight line from the left edge at 70% height to the right edge at 30% height. Upper-left region = sachet-red, lower-right = sachet-yellow.

tear-notch.$value: Isosceles triangle, 16 units wide, 12 deep, cut into the right edge 24 units below the top crimp

mark.$value: Persona '2' glyph centred on the yellow region, glyph height = 40% of sachet width

two-mark.$description: The shared '2' convenience mark. Each persona draws its own glyph (Section 18.6) inside this construction box.

box.$value: width:height = 1:1.25, baseline at box bottom, cap height = 80% of box height

min-stroke.$description: Minimum stroke as a fraction of glyph height (= 2px at 16px).

min-counter.$description: Minimum open counter (the bowl of the 2) as a fraction of glyph width.

min-legible.$description: Every persona '2' must read as a 2 at 16px.

meaning.$value: Felt time, not a cook-time claim (Section 18.2). Any copy stating actual vs felt cook time needs Nestle review.

steam-curl.$description: Constant across all seven worlds (Section 18.1). Sizes relative to the vessel rim width W.

spacing.$value: 0.18W between wisp bases, group centred on the rim

shape.$value: S-curve with exactly 2 inflections, rising vertically, tips taper to 0

stroke.$value: persona shape.stroke with round caps (Lull: filled shapes, no stroke)

lockup-slot.$description: Reserved for the brand team; left empty in all work (Section 22).

clear-space.$value: 0.25 x slot height on all four sides

entry-height.$description: Fraction of panel height from the top, identical at left and right edges of every panel, so panels reorder freely.

entry-angle.$description: Degrees. The thread is horizontal for the first and last 4% of panel width.

focus.$description: WCAG 2.4.7 / 2.4.11. Every persona role.focus must reach 3:1 against role.bg and role.surface.

style.$value: solid outline following the element radius

density.$description: Meaning of persona density 1-5 in a static scene: maximum distinct props and minimum negative space (fraction of frame left as plain background).

toy.$description: Mascot medium v3.1 (decided 2026-10-07): 3D designer vinyl art toys in one rule, 'streetwear creatures': human-style bodies, poses and streetwear with creature heads and skin. See system/mascot-style-v3.md. References: brief/references/inspo/mascots-v3/.

medium.$value: 3D designer vinyl toy (collectible blind-box series), rendered stills and turntables

scale.$value: 15 cm figure equivalent; every mascot on the same base height, heights vary only through head and hair

head-ratio.$description: Head height as a fraction of figure height: big-head art-toy proportion.

body.$value: Shared armature for all seven: human-style torso and limbs with relaxed streetwear posture, 4-finger hands sized to hold a real MAGGI pack, chunky rounded shoes, an 8 mm round display base

face.$value: Creature faces only (cat, devil-imp, axolotl, sprite, glow-creature, box-head): non-human skin colours, no realistic human faces, no child faces

outfit.$value: Contemporary streetwear (hoodie, puffer, apron, jersey, jacket) chosen per persona; never cultural or national dress

pack.$value: Each figure holds its real MAGGI pack at 1:6 scale as a separate prop; health badges printed illegible

camera.$value: Hero: three-quarter view, 35 degrees off front, eye level at chest height, 85 mm lens look. Turntable: 8 views at 45 degree steps

lighting.$value: Soft studio: large key 45 degrees top-left, fill at 30% from right, rim light from behind, soft contact shadow on the base. Lull and Mise use their scene light instead

background.$value: Seamless sweep in the persona role.bg colour; transparent-background PNG exported alongside

deliverables.$value: Per mascot: hero render, 8-view turntable sheet, 3 poses (hero with pack, sachet moment, reaction), material callout sheet; 2048x2048 PNG with alpha

style-rule.$value: Streetwear creatures: human-style proportions, attitude and outfits; creature heads, ears, horns, tails and non-human skin colours. Never an ordinary human, never a food object as a head

motion.$description: Shared motion grid (Section 20). Personas may change timing and amplitude, never the token names.

bar.$description: One bar = the felt two minutes, compressed to 2 s.

platform-fallback.$description: Only when a platform requires it.

ease-settle.$description: Damped landing. Spring equivalent in motion.spring.ease-settle for engines that support springs.

duration.$description: All clip lengths are whole bars (Section 20).

layer-order.$description: Back to front. SVG document order must match (see system/rig-spec.json).

max-flashes-per-second.$description: Hard ceiling (Section 20). Validators reject persona pulse rates at or above this.

reduced-motion.$description: prefers-reduced-motion behaviour and the reduced variant of every clip. No autoplay with sound.

mode.$value: poster frame + opacity cross-fades only; no translate, scale, rotate, squash or parallax

max-flash-area.$description: Max fraction of a frame that may change relative luminance by more than 10% in one flash. Conservative reading of WCAG 2.3.1.

loop-seam.$value: First and last frame must match; checked automatically at Gate 4.

ui.$description: UI transitions on web/ pages, not character animation. Snapped to the 24 fps grid; direct feedback stays <= 250ms and never blocks input.

sound.$description: Section 18.8. Seven 2-second signatures tuned to one C lydian stack; together they form the sonic logo.

chord.$description: C lydian stack: root, fifth, third, seventh, ninth, thirteenth, sharp eleventh.

synthesis.$value: Python + ffmpeg only; no third-party samples.

accessibility.$value: Every audio asset ships a silent version and captions or a visual equivalent.

locale.$description: Second token axis (Section 18.9). Persona controls look; locale controls props, flavour names, language lines and cultural cues. Every pack is 'validate locally' until reviewed by local collaborators.

$value: reviewed by local collaborators before use
English on artwork; locale lines only inside locale packs

card.$description: Mascot card radar (Section 18.7). One series per card, so no legend box: the card title names it. Stat labels stay in text ink, never the series colour.

status.$value: Draft scores are design judgement, to be validated against research (Section 18.7).

packMechanic.concept: Peel-and-swap sticker sachet, deliberately misregistered print

constraint.rule: Controlled clash: fixed rules for which colours may collide

checks.misregistration: 6 units down-right at the 1024 canvas, constant
grammar: Only the listed clash pairs may touch without an ink keyline.
Any other two colours that meet are separated by an ink keyline of the persona stroke width.
At most three clash colours plus ink and paper in any one region.
Text sits on ink, paper or a single flat colour, never across a clash seam.
Meaning is never carried by colour alone: stickers carry shape and label.

distinguish.why: clash pair must still vibrate under CVD
